signInTitle: Sign in to send your request
signInText: Your account keeps every clinic's answer, your files and your conversations in one place.
signIn: Sign in or create an account
sent: Your request has been sent. You will get an email when a clinic answers.
descriptionPlaceholder: Which teeth, what your dentist at home said, anything that worries you…
filesHint: A recent panoramic X-ray (OPG) helps the clinic give you a realistic price. Photos, PDFs and DICOM files are fine. Only the clinics you send this request to can see them.
uploadFailed: The file could not be uploaded. Check its type and size.
privacyHint: Clinics see only your first name and country until you choose to share your contact details with one of them.
consent: I agree to share this request, including any health details and files in it, with the clinics listed above so they can prepare an estimate.
disclaimer: Estimates are provisional: the final treatment plan is decided by the dentist after an examination. This platform does not give medical advice.
failed: Your request could not be sent. Please try again.
